ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (as amended by Laws No. 36/2014, 48/2016, 177/2020 and 154/2022); Executive Regulations issued by Prime Ministerial Decree No. 950 of 2003 (as amended); Law No. 159 of 1981 on Joint-Stock Companies, Partnerships Limited by Shares and Limited Liability Companies, as amended by Law No. 21 of 2021 mandating the beneficial-ownership register; Law No. 8 of 2015 on Terrorist Entities and Terrorist Financing; Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976; implementing circulars of the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU) and the Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA); Central Bank of Egypt sanctions-compliance circulars.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Commercial Registry Extract of each direct corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Egypt is NOT a Contracting Party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; required chain: home-country notary public, then home-country Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication, then legalization by the Egyptian Embassy/Consulate in the issuing jurisdiction)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and UBO declaration of each direct corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country Companies Registry or licensed corporate services provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (same triple chain: notary public, home-country Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Egyptian Embassy/Consulate)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Arabic translation of all legalized shareholder and UBO documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Egyptian certified translation office or licensed legalized translator
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Attestation of translator signature before the Notary Public (Saray) or by the competent Translation Department of the Egyptian Ministry of Justice

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening under Law No. 80/2002 Art. 2(1) and Art. 3 of every shareholder, director and ultimate beneficial owner against: (i) UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions Lists (UNSCR 1267/1989, 1373, 1718, 2231 and successor resolutions); (ii) the Egyptian terrorist-entity listing under Law No. 8 of 2015; (iii) sanctions and PEP registers published by EMLCU, the Central Bank of Egypt and the FRA. OFAC and EU sanctions lists, while not directly binding under Egyptian law, must be checked as best practice because the target payment rails (Kickstarter/Stripe, PayPal) apply them extraterritorially. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for any foreign PEPs, shell companies, politically exposed families, and persons from high-risk jurisdictions; a signed UBO declaration must be maintained in the incorporation file and updated within 30 days of any ownership change. The low-risk AML classification of the tabletop-gaming accessories business does not exempt the formation agent from CDD obligations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI One-Stop-Shop for Investors and the Commercial Registry Directorate of the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade; electronic name pre-reservation is initiated via the Invest-in-Egypt portal (https://www.invest-in-egypt.gov.eg) followed by physical filing at the GAFI Investor Services Center, Cairo.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal name of every Egyptian LLC must be written in Arabic and must contain the legal-form designation 'شركة ذات مسئولية محدودة' (LLC). The Arabic name is the controlling statutory name; a Latin-alphabet transliteration is filed for banking, customs, trademark and payment-processor purposes but must be a phonetic transliteration of the Arabic name rather than an independent English brand. The name must be derived from the permitted corporate purpose, an approved personal or family name, or a distinctive invented mark; it must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing Egyptian registered trade name, trademark, or company name. For the dice-casting business, a recommended Arabic descriptor is 'أدوات ألعاب الأدوار اللوحية' (tabletop role-play game accessories) to avoid any gambling connotation.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: 'بنك' (Bank) - requires Central Bank of Egypt licensing
Sovereign and state connotations: 'الجمهورية' (Republic), 'مصر' (Egypt), 'الوطنية' (National), 'الحكومية' (Government), 'القوات المسلحة' (Armed Forces)
'قناة السويس' (Suez Canal) and economic-zone names - require special-zone concession
Names of unrelated natural persons or third-party legal entities without written consent
Words indicating a different corporate form such as 'مساهمة' (Joint-Stock) or 'Holding' unless the minimum capital and FRA conditions are met
Gambling, lottery or games-of-chance tokens: 'قمار' (gambling) and 'نرد' (dice) must be avoided in the Arabic name; use 'ألعاب أدوار لوحية' (tabletop role-play games) instead
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant receives a written reasoned refusal from GAFI/Commercial Registry. Within 15 days of the refusal, file a written grievance with the GAFI Complaints and Grievances Committee via the Investor Services Center, attaching a corrected re-filing proposal and supporting trademark or consent letters. If the grievance is dismissed, judicial annulment may be sought before the Administrative Court of the Egyptian Council of State within 60 days of the final administrative rejection. A name reservation is renewable once for an additional 30 days while the notarization of the memorandum of association remains pending.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not acceptable as the sole registered seat for a handcrafted dice manufacturing LLC. The Commercial Registry and GAFI records must state a physical address in Egypt at which legal service and tax notices can be delivered; a licensed administrative business center may be used only for the administrative office provided the manufacturing workshop/factory premises are separately documented and registered with the competent industrial licensing authorities. A purely virtual address or PO Box will trigger audit rejection, refusal of the tax card, and potential strike-off under Law No. 159 of 1981.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High - quantified at 75% during the first 12 months after incorporation: unannounced on-site visits may be conducted by the Egyptian Tax Authority compliance unit to verify the actual production seat, by GAFI/Commercial Registry officers to confirm registered-office existence, and by municipal and occupational-safety inspectors to check epoxy-resin handling, ventilation, storage and waste-disposal conditions.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended by Law No. 4 of 2024, read together with Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; applicable sections include Articles 1, 20, 21, 24, 43, 51, and 68 on LLC formation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, share capital, and managers.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Establishment and Licensing Department, with final entry into the Commercial Registry administered by the Ministry of Justice.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association, filed electronically through GAFI's Investor Services Portal and legalized by GAFI.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an Egyptian LLC; the members fix the issued capital in the Memorandum. Cash subscription amounts must be deposited in a temporary bank escrow account with a licensed Egyptian bank and blocked until the GAFI certificate of incorporation is issued, after which the funds are released to the company treasury.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the founder's subscription of the initial issued share capital be and is hereby approved, and the General Manager is directed to deposit all cash contributions into the company's escrow account and to file the incorporation instruments with GAFI promptly. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company be fixed at [address], Cairo, Egypt, within the ordinary jurisdiction of the Commercial Registry. RESOLVED, that [Name] act as General Manager, [Name] as Financial Officer, and [Name] as Compliance Officer, each with powers not exceeding statutory limits and the approved operating budget. The resolution was passed unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Investor Services Portal / Name Reservation Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in or register on GAFI's Investor Services Portal. Submit at least three transliterated Arabic names in order of preference. Complete the due diligence questionnaire and pay the name fee. On approval, download the name reservation certificate, valid for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Founder government-issued ID (national ID or passport)
Power of attorney if applying through an agent
Proposed LLC names in Arabic and English
Business activity description for ISIC 3240 / tabletop RPG dice manufacturing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is rejected due to similarity or public-policy conflict, submit alternative names within 5 working days; if the refusal is wrongful, appeal in writing to GAFI's Name Committee with a certificate of commercial registry search.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Notary Public / GAFI Legalization Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed Egyptian lawyer or notary to prepare the Arabic Memorandum and Articles of Association. The instruments must recite the subscribers, capital shares, registered office, manager appointment, and object clause. Have all shareholders or members sign before a notary, then obtain GAFI legalization stamp on the signed instruments.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate
Draft Memorandum of Association
Draft Articles of Association
Shareholders' official IDs and tax ID numbers, if any
Notarized power of attorney for legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI returns the instruments for correction, amend the offending clauses, re-notarize the corrected pages, and request same-day re-legalization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Deposit in Temporary Escrow Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian bank that accepts GAFI incorporation escrow accounts
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the notarized draft Memorandum and Articles and the name certificate to the chosen bank. Open a temporary corporate account in the company's name with the caption 'pending incorporation.' Deposit the subscribed cash capital and obtain a certificate of block deposit. The bank certificate must identify the company, subscribers, and deposited amount.
required_dossiers: Notarized draft Memorandum and Articles
Name reservation certificate
Shareholders' resolution directing the deposit
Passport or national ID and specimen signature cards
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank declines the escrow, request GAFI to issue a standard bank authorization letter identifying an alternative licensed bank and reopen the account on the same day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Establishment and Licensing Department – Investor Services Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete electronic application. Upload the scanned notarized Memorandum and Articles, bank capital certificate, registered-office lease deed, and identification documents. Pay the GAFI e-filing fees using the official payment gateway. Keep the electronic acknowledgment and case number for follow-up.
required_dossiers: Notarized and legalized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certificate of capital block deposit
Certified copy of registered-office lease or title deed with municipal code
Founder identification and power of attorney
GAFI standard establishment application form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues a query letter or incomplete-data notice, respond through the portal within 15 business days with corrected Arabic documents and a line-by-line cover letter; appeals of adverse admissibility rulings may be filed before the GAFI internal complaints unit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Commercial Registry Entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Commercial Registration / Ministry of Justice Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After GAFI approval, pay the final fees and collect the Certificate of Incorporation. GAFI transmits the incorporation data to the Commercial Registry. Verify the Commercial Registry extract, obtain the commercial registration number, and retain the certified extract for banking and licensing purposes.
required_dossiers: GAFI approval and fee receipt
Final notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certificate of capital block deposit showing release authorization
Power of attorney
Commercial Registry application and lease evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Commercial Registry queries inconsistent officer names or registered address, use GAFI's electronic correction notice to update the documents, finalize with a second inspection by the local registry, and pay top-up fees if assessed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Governance, Tax, and Environmental or Physical Licensing Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI; Ministry of Environment – Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA); General Civil Defense Directorate; Ministry of Finance Tax Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board or general meeting, pass the first resolution, and adopt the minute book. Complete tax-card registration at the local Tax Authority for income tax and value-added tax. For the casting workshop, register the facility with EEAA's industrial classification window and obtain Civil Defense clearance before beginning commercial operation.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation
Commercial Registry extract
Minutes of first board resolution
Lease or ownership documents of production premises
Process and product safety data sheet for epoxy resins
EEAA facility registration form
Civil Defense inspection request
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If environmental or Civil Defense clearance flags safety deficiencies, submit the approved corrective action plan, upgrade ventilation and fire-extinguishing assets, and request re-inspection within 14 days; production must remain suspended until compliance certificate is issued.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) / GAFI Industrial Licensing Center – not a mandatory pre-operating license for ISIC 3240 low-volume RPG dice casting; the facility must still be recorded through GAFI's national commercial registry activity listing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No general industrial operating license is mandated for this activity; where a governorate requires professional activity registration, the relevant permit is the 'Commercial Activity Operation Certificate' issued by the local Governorate licensing office.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) – Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B (Environmental Registration) for small-scale epoxy resin dice casting; a full EIA report is not triggered for ISIC 3240 / NAICS 339930 production, but a simplified environmental self-monitoring statement must be filed
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Process wastewater pH 6.5–8.5, BOD ≤ 300 mg/L, COD ≤ 600 mg/L, TSS ≤ 300 mg/L if routed to public sewer under Law 48/1982; epoxy VOCs in workroom air limited to an EEAA-recognized workplace threshold equivalent to 50 ppm TWA; hazardous resin waste must be segregated, labeled, and consigned to an EEAA-licensed waste contractor.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense fire safety clearance is required before operation: heat and smoke detectors, ABC extinguishers, fire cabinets for resin storage, and egress plans. Occupational clearance includes structural load verification of casting benches, adequate lighting and ventilation, and workplace injury prevention inspection under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) under Ministry of Finance, electronic portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; indirect tax clearance integrated with Egyptian Customs Authority for export verification.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For foreign-owned LLC: (1) incorporate and obtain Commercial Registry certificate through General Authority for Investment (GAFI); (2) submit attested constitutional documents, lease/address proof and board resolution to ETA; (3) obtain Tax Identification Number (TIN) via ETA centralized registration; (4) complete VAT registration on ETA portal (mandatory regardless of threshold for exporters), receive electronic registration certificate and e-invoicing authentication credentials.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election; statutory options include simplified cash-basis small-business tax regime, sectoral incentives under Investment Law No. 72/2017, and special treatment in free zones or Suez Canal Economic Zone. No hybrid mismatch elective regimes are available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) under Law No. 67/2016
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable supplies of goods; EGP 250,000 threshold for certain services per Executive Regulations. Importers and exporters are required to register irrespective of threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing and e-receipt system: all B2B invoices must be issued in XML format, transmitted in real time to ETA via approved API or cabinet portal, carry a QR code, and obtain automated ETA validation codes before being deemed fiscally compliant.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to goods physically removed from Egypt where the registered exporter supplies such goods under genuine export transactions, the proceeds in foreign currency are repatriated to an Egyptian licensed bank, and all statutory export declaration and Customs release formalities are completed. Services consumed wholly outside Egypt may also qualify under ETA guidance.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Egyptian Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document)
Bill of Lading (or Air Waybill), signed commercial invoice and packing list
Foreign contract/purchase order plus Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing export proceeds credited to an Egyptian bank account in hard currency
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA may conduct retrospective audits on export files, bill of lading authenticity and remittance evidence. Failure to substantiate zero-rating or failure to repatriate proceeds within 180 days results in reversal of the 0% rate, VAT assessed at 14% on the invoice value, monthly delay penalty of 2% (capped at 180%), and potential fines up to 100% of the tax differential. Deliberate fraudulent documentation triggers criminal penalties under Law No. 67/2016 and Tax Procedures Law No. 96/2016.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) - the sole monetary, banking and foreign-exchange regulatory authority under Law No. 194 of 2020 (Central Bank and Banking System Law), which superseded the 1951 CBE statute and the 2003 Banking Law; all FX transactions must be executed through CBE-licensed banks or licensed exchange bureaus.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Since the CBE decision of 6 March 2024, the EGP operates under a unified, freely floating interbank exchange regime with no parallel market; Egypt adheres to IMF Article VIII current-account convertibility. Current-account flows (trade settlement, service payments, royalties, and profit remittances) are convertible upon submission of standard banking documentation without discretionary CBE licensing. Capital-account flows are asymetric: inward direct investment into an Egyptian LLC is liberalized and requires no prior CBE approval, whereas outward resident direct investment and cross-border resident lending remain subject to CBE authorization. Profit and dividend repatriation to non-resident shareholders is uncapped subject to: (i) the CBE FX Transaction Form, (ii) audited financial statements and the general assembly dividend resolution, (iii) tax clearance evidencing the 10% dividend withholding tax under Law 91/2005, and (iv) the Foreign Capital Import Certificate evidencing the original hard-currency injection. Proceeds retained in onshore domiciled USD/EUR accounts are unrestricted; any sale of foreign currency must occur through licensed banks at interbank rates.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For goods exports (ISIC 3240 polyhedral dice), foreign-currency proceeds must be credited to a licensed Egyptian bank within a maximum of 180 days from the date of the customs export declaration filed through the NAFEZA unified electronic window; extensions require the bank's prior approval and documented payment terms. The mandatory surrender ratios applied in 2022 (100%, later reduced to 50%) were abolished on 6 March 2024; exporters now retain 100% of export receipts in onshore domiciled foreign-currency accounts and may convert to EGP at their own commercial discretion. Marketplace receipts from Kickstarter, Stripe, and PayPal constitute statutory export proceeds and must be repatriated through the Egyptian banking system, reconciled to the corresponding NAFEZA export declaration; accumulation of proceeds in offshore accounts beyond the statutory window contravenes Law 194/2020 and is punishable by imprisonment and fines of up to EGP 10 million.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Export Proceeds Domiciled Account + EGP Operational Account
USD Domiciled Export Account + EGP Current Account
EGP Operating Account with Linked USD Sub-Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Emirates NBD Egypt S.A.E. (formerly BNP Paribas Egypt)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Trade Settlement Account + EGP Operating Account
EGP Operating Account only; USD facility subject to enhanced business-case approval

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: LOW for use as the principal treasury or end-destination account; acceptable only as a settlement pre-node that sweeps daily to the Egyptian bank. Legal constraints: Law 194/2020 reserves foreign-exchange dealings to CBE-licensed banks and exchange bureaus; offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex, Revolut) are not authorized to domicile Egyptian export proceeds, cannot issue the Foreign Capital Import Certificate, and cannot open EGP accounts for resident Egyptian entities. The LLC may use Stripe/PayPal as collection access layers, but each unit of foreign currency must be repatriated to the Egyptian banking system within the prescribed window; offshore retention beyond 180 days constitutes a violation subject to fines up to EGP 10 million and potential bank-account freeze.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory: at least one Egyptian-resident director/managing partner and each authorized signatory must attend an in-person compliance interview at the bank branch; fully remote corporate account opening is not available for Egyptian LLCs. Non-resident shareholders may delegate through a power of attorney notarized at the Egyptian consulate and legalized/apostilled, accompanied by video-KYC identity verification; the resident director holds signatory responsibility. Onboarding requires original Commercial Registry extract, tax card, the Beneficial Ownership Register extract under Law 179/2022, board resolution appointing signatories, and passport copies; typical completion period is 5-15 business days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency, low-ticket cross-border credits from Kickstarter/Stripe/PayPal with intermittent refund and chargeback debits forming an atypical B2C export pattern
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Monthly platform settlement reports (Stripe and PayPal CSV exports); (ii) board-approved written e-commerce collection policy; (iii) order-level downloads matched to commercial invoices and NAFEZA export declarations; (iv) refund and chargeback register with customer correspondence; (v) an activity memorandum explaining the tabletop-gaming niche; (vi) VAT and income-tax filing receipts demonstrating tributary coherence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ultimate beneficial ownership and opacity of the initial capital-injection source
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Beneficial Ownership Register updated under Law 179/2022, disclosing every natural person controlling 25% or more; (ii) corporate registry extract from the shareholder's home jurisdiction; (iii) passports and bank-verified proof of address dated within 3 months; (iv) source-of-wealth and source-of-funds declarations; (v) the incoming SWIFT credit advice matching the declared capital increase; (vi) the Foreign Capital Import Certificate issued by the receiving Egyptian bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Product-description screening flags: wording such as 'sharp-edged polyhedral dice' may trigger sanctions/armaments filters
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Customs-broker certified HS 9504.90 classification memorandum (table or parlour games, non-military); (ii) NAFEZA export declarations carrying the correct HS code; (iii) product catalogue photographs and dimensional specifications; (iv) Safety Data Sheet for the epoxy resin confirming non-hazardous polymer classification; (v) supplier compliance letter from the resin manufacturer; (vi) a written explanatory statement addressed to the bank's compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment routing through third-party FX aggregators or offshore EMIs rather than directly into the Egyptian banking system
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Executed service agreement with the aggregator confirming its role as a pure collection agent; (ii) configuration evidence showing settlement debits flowing directly to the Egyptian domiciled USD account; (iii) a monthly reconciliation ledger of all aggregator settlements; (iv) CBE export-proceeds declarations and NAFEZA records; (v) an undertaking letter confirming that no unrepatriated export proceeds are held outside Egypt beyond the 180-day statutory window.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity injection from the non-resident shareholder is routed via SWIFT MT103 from the investor's foreign bank to EG_LLC's USD account at the Egyptian bank; the wire narrative must state 'Capital Increase / Subscription to Paid-In Capital of EG_LLC' and correspond to the bank-selected CBE FX Transaction Form category for Capital Account - Direct Investment in a Resident Enterprise. The verification bundle comprises: (i) GAFI-registered capital-increase notification in the Unified Commercial Registry; (ii) shareholders' resolution authorizing the increase; (iii) notarized subscription deed in Arabic; (iv) updated ownership schedule confirming non-resident shareholding percentages; (v) source-of-funds statements from the sending bank; (vi) the LLC tax card. No prior CBE license is required for a cash equity increase; no mandatory conversion to EGP applies. Upon credit, the bank issues the Foreign Capital Import Certificate, which is the operative document for future dividend and capital repatriation. Kickstarter/Stripe/PayPal payouts must be configured to credit the same Egyptian USD account directly under the export-of-goods purpose.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For production inputs (epoxy resin, pigments, molds, packaging): (i) small-value pre-payments on open account via SWIFT MT103, purpose coded 'Advance Payment for Imported Goods', supported by the pro-forma invoice, the NAFEZA import declaration, and supplier bank details; (ii) documentary collections (DP/DA) for mid-value recurring resin purchases; (iii) irrevocable documentary letters of credit (UCP 600) when supplier credit assurance is required, noting first-tier Egyptian banks typically apply a USD 25,000-50,000 minimum per L/C; (iv) revolving L/C structures for continuous raw-material supply. The LLC must complete importer registration with the Customs Authority through NAFEZA and comply with ACI advance cargo-information filing for containerized shipments. Maintain a USD liquidity buffer equivalent to three months of raw-material purchases to reduce conversion-timing risk; EGP/USD conversion is executed at the bank's screen interbank rate.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forward contracts (up to 12 months) with the corporate bank, supported by documented underlying import or export exposure and settled by physical EGP/USD delivery at maturity.
Cross-currency FX swaps (USD/EGP and EUR/USD) for tenor-matched liquidity management, typically up to 6 months, executed under an ISDA/CSA-documented bank line.

Standardized EGP/USD FX futures listed on the Egyptian Exchange (EGX), cleared through the Misr Central Clearing, Depository and Registry (MCDR), available to Egyptian corporates for hedging since October 2020.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are legally available offshore only for non-resident counterparties; the onshore LLC is expected to use deliverable forwards because the unified interbank rate regime post-March 2024 eliminated the EGP pricing distortion that historically motivated NDF usage.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (e-filed on ETA gateway) with audited financial statements attached
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after fiscal year-end; calendar-year LLC: on or before 30 April, extendable to 30 June via tax advisor e-confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 2% monthly late-payment interest (capped at 100% of tax due); late-filing fine up to EGP 50,000; tax clearance certificate blocked and enforced collection or travel ban after continued default

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual salary tax settlement and employee wage certificates (annual payroll withholding reconciliation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) payroll e-filing module
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual reconciliation on or before end of February following the tax year; monthly Form 41 remittances by the 15th of the following month (recurring)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly 2% interest on unremitted payroll tax; EGP 500 to EGP 5,000 fixed fines per late declaration; managers personally liable for wrongful non-withholding

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Recurring monthly VAT returns and annual VAT reconciliation declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) VAT e-filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly VAT return by end of the month following each tax period; annual reconciliation filed with the corporate income tax package
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine of EGP 5,000 to EGP 50,000 per month; monthly delay interest of 2% on VAT due; e-invoicing certificate suspension for persistent non-filers

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO register confirmation and ownership update statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment (GAFI) / Commercial Registry under AML Law 80/2002
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation before 30 June of each year and within 30 days after any shareholder or beneficial-owner change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to EGP 500,000 under the AML regime for inaccurate UBO data; registry suspension leading to GAFI-initiated dissolution after two consecutive years of default

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial registry renewal and statutory records attestation (5-year cycle)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry (Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade) with GAFI coordination
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based renewal every 5 years; annual attestation statement due within 30 days of registration anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Daily registry delay fines and final administrative strike-off; de-registration triggers liquidation and loss of the limited liability shield

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ordinary General Assembly approval of annual accounts and auditor appointment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders under Law 159/1981; minutes retained at registered office and produced to GAFI or ETA upon inspection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of fiscal year-end (calendar-year LLC: by 30 June)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Managers liable for damages and criminal fine up to EGP 20,000; resolution challengeable as void; GAFI may compel an extraordinary general assembly

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No quantitative exemption: every Egyptian LLC must appoint at least one ETA-registered statutory auditor irrespective of turnover; banks, insurance companies and listed entities require an auditor registered with the financial regulator
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), converged with IFRS; IFRS as issued permitted for consolidated group reporting and foreign-parent reporting

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Shareholder registry and UBO record must be annually confirmed on the GAFI/Commercial Registry platform before 30 June; any share transfer requires transfer approval entry in the register of members and UBO re-declaration within 30 days
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (shareholder register with share-transfer log)
General Assembly and Managers' minute book
Beneficial owner (UBO) register per AML Law 80/2002 executive regulations
Statutory accounting ledgers and inventory records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 150 – 600 per year for a Cairo registered-office address service or GAFI/Commercial Registry representation agent
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 600 – 1,800 per year for a small LLC audit by an ETA-registered public accountant

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27.5% on the first EGP 80,000,000 of annual taxable profit and 22.5% on the tranche above EGP 80,000,000 (Income Tax Law No. 91/2005 as amended by Law No. 26/2020). For an EG_LLC with taxable profit below EGP 80M, the applicable marginal rate is 27.5%; the commonly quoted Egyptian headline rate of 22.5% applies only to the excess.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: GAFI-approved projects under Investment Law No. 72/2017 may benefit from a 5-year CIT holiday (extended to 10 years if established on State-owned land or in specially designated zones), a 50% deduction of salaries of newly hired Egyptian employees, and a 30-50% deduction for R&D expenditure. Qualifying micro/small enterprises under Law No. 152/2020 may elect a final turnover-based tax of 1% in lieu of net-profit CIT. Export-oriented manufacturers inside the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) may access additional customs and input-import privileges. All incentives require prior GAFI/ETA approval and strict compliance with conditions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Profit Tax Return 'Form 7' (نموذج 7) for juridical persons; filed annually through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) unified electronic filing system (e-Tax portal, www.eta.gov.eg). Payroll tax returns (Form 2) and dividend/interest/royalty withholding reconciliation are filed separately on monthly and annual schedules.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; CIT return and payment due within 4 months after fiscal year-end. Payroll and WHT settlement are monthly with annual reconciliation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months from the close of the taxable year (Article 31, Law No. 91/2005). Example: fiscal year ending 31 December 2025 must be filed and paid by 30 April 2026.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 – Registration Data (Tax Card No., Commercial Registry No.)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter the LLC's Tax Card number, Commercial Registry number, and General Authority for Investment (GAFI) file number, if applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact English/Arabic registered name of the LLC. A foreign-owned LLC must obtain the Tax Card through the Investment One-Stop Shop before filing; enter the Egyptian legal representative's national ID number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Specify the commencement and closing dates of the 12-month taxable period covered by the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Egyptian LLC always files on its own 12-month cycle regardless of the foreign parent's fiscal year; the first return may cover a short or split period and must be reported as such.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All income from manufacturing, assembly, and sale of tabletop gaming polyhedral dice sets, including crowdfunding contributions received via Kickstarter and Stripe/PayPal payment rails, gross of gateway fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report total revenue attributable to the Egyptian manufacturing and commercial activity. E-commerce gateway fees are deductible only with supporting merchant statements; do not net commissions unless invoiced by the third-party payment processor.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 5 – Deductible Costs of Sales and Operating Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Epoxy resin, molds, pigments, packaging, subcontract manufacturing, factory rent, wages, depreciation, marketing, and logistics costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Purchases of raw materials from the foreign parent must be at arm's length and be supported by contemporaneous documentation (TP annexure); otherwise the ETA will disallow a pro-rata portion of the cost and impose a 27.5% tax adjustment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 7 – Adjusted Taxable Profit Before Reliefs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Book profit after tax accounting reconciliation: add back non-deductible items (fines, personal expenses, excess entertainment, impairment without formal approval, related-party interest exceeding the 4:1 debt-to-equity safe harbor).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest on shareholder/foreign-parent loans exceeding the Egyptian thin-capitalization ratio (4:1 debt-to-equity) is non-deductible; the parent must provide loan agreements, Sworn statement of beneficial ownership, and computation of arm's-length interest.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply the statutory rate to the taxable profit: 27.5% on the first EGP 80,000,000 and 22.5% on the excess.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute standalone at the entity level; if the LLC is a member of an Egyptian tax group (rare, requires prior approval), apply group relief rules instead of individual computation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 11 – Tax Credits and Incentive Deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deduct prior-year tax losses within the 5-year carryforward limit, Investment Law holiday (if GAFI-approved), research/employment incentives, and exempt domestic dividend income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credit: attach evidence of foreign tax paid (assessment, TRC) for treaty-protected foreign-source income. Egypt allows a unilateral credit under Article 39 of Law 91/2005 up to the Egyptian tax attributable to that income; a DTA may expand or limit the credit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declare aggregate value of controlled transactions with the foreign parent and related parties, transfer pricing method applied (CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split), and identity/host country of counterparties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory whenever any related-party transaction occurs, irrespective of amount. If total controlled transactions reach EGP 30,000,000 in the tax year, the Local File must be uploaded electronically through the ETA TP portal before the return deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 15 – Signature and Licensed Tax Adviser Certification
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of the LLC's general manager/legal representative, and certification by the accredited Egyptian tax accountant/adviser (AOTCA member).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A licensed Egyptian tax adviser must co-sign the return; the signature of the non-resident shareholder alone is not accepted. The legal representative bears statutory responsibility for the accuracy of the filing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fixed delinquency fine of EGP 1,000-EGP 5,000 plus a monthly delayed-payment surcharge of 2% of the assessed tax for each month or fraction of a month of delay, with no maximum cap. Failure to register for the Tax Card incurs EGP 5,000-EGP 20,000. Fraudulent returns trigger the tax evasion sanctions under Law No. 195/2022 (imprisonment 1-5 years, fines up to EGP 20,000,000). Persistent non-filing may lead to ETA best-judgment assessment and enforced collection.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on gross dividends distributed by an Egyptian LLC to shareholders, resident or non-resident (Article 56(3) of Law No. 91/2005). The LLC is the statutory withholding agent; the tax is due at distribution irrespective of the shareholder's residence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident shareholder must obtain a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) for the relevant calendar year, legalized/apostilled, and submit it together with a 'Treaty Relief / Exemption Application' to the ETA before the dividend payment date, through the Egyptian LLC as withholding agent. The application must include proof of beneficial ownership and an article-by-article DTA analysis. The ETA issues a written approval of the reduced rate; if no prior approval is obtained, the LLC withholds 10% and the shareholder may file a refund claim with the ETA against the DTA. The same prior-approval protocol applies to treaty relief on interest and royalties.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on gross royalties, technical fees, and interest paid to non-residents is 20% (Article 56, Law 91/2005). Under Egypt's DTAs, treaty rates are typically reduced to 10-15% for royalties and 10-12% for interest, subject to the beneficial ownership clause; the reduced rate is available only with an ETA-approved treaty relief application and a valid TRC. Interest on shareholder loans also remains subject to Egypt's thin-capitalization limitation (4:1 debt-to-equity).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File mandatory when the aggregate value of related-party transactions (purchases, sales, services, royalties, interest, intercompany financing) in a tax year equals or exceeds EGP 30,000,000. Master File mandatory when the worldwide multinational group (including the EG_LLC) reports consolidated annual revenue of at least EGP 6,000,000,000. Country-by-Country Report applies when the group's consolidated revenue exceeds EUR 750,000,000. Even below the Local File threshold, the Form 7 TP annexure is mandatory for any controlled transaction, and contemporaneous arm's-length documentation must be held available for ETA inspection.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No standalone Economic Substance Regulations form (i.e., no UAE-style ESR return) is applicable in Egypt; however, substance is enforced through the GAAR in Article 30 of Law No. 91/2005, the beneficial ownership test under the DTAs, and Egyptian CFC rules. The LLC must maintain a physical office in Egypt, active management exercised within Egypt, adequate staff, and production/distribution activity commensurate with its turnover. If the ETA or the EMLCU determines that the entity lacks commercial substance and is used as a conduit, the transactions may be re-characterized, treaty benefits denied, and non-resident shareholders assessed as having a permanent establishment in Egypt.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsifying Form 7, understating Kickstarter/Stripe/PayPal international sales, fabricating supplier invoices for resin/molds, booking personal expenses as deductible manufacturing costs, or concealing offshore cash reserves.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law No. 195/2022 amending the tax evasion regime: imprisonment for 1 to 5 years and a fine of EGP 100,000 up to EGP 20,000,000, in addition to recovery of the evaded tax, the 2% monthly delay surcharge, and ETA best-judgment assessment with penalties up to 100% of the tax difference.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The general manager and directors are jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax where the evasion was executed on their instruction; Egyptian courts pierce the corporate veil in fraud cases, ordering restitution from personal assets, preventive property seizure, travel bans (listings at the ETA collection department), and imprisonment of the responsible natural person.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare/maintain the Local File or comparability analysis when controlled transactions exceed the EGP 30,000,000 threshold; selling dice below cost to the foreign parent to shift profit outside Egypt; providing false TP annexure data.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA adjustment of Egyptian taxable profit under the most appropriate arm's-length method, additional CIT at 27.5% on the upward adjustment, 2% monthly delay surcharge, and administrative fines under the ETA TP documentation rules (including daily fines for late or incomplete TP filing). Deliberate false documentation is prosecuted as tax evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who certify the TP annexure with materially false data are personally liable for the adjusted tax difference and surcharges if the entity cannot pay; willful profit-shifting with fraudulent intent exposes them to evasion penalties, travel bans, and joint civil liability.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The LLC has no real factory lease, no employees in Egypt, no actual dice production, and is used solely to route cross-border sales commissions to a zero-tax offshore intermediary; intercompany invoices for 'management fees' or 'IP royalties' are issued without support.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disallowance of all artificial intercompany fees; re-characterization under Article 30 GAAR; denial of treaty benefits on dividend/royalty payments for lack of beneficial ownership; the ETA may assess the non-resident parent directly on an Egyptian permanent establishment basis; company dissolution and commercial registry strike-off under Companies Law No. 159/1981.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee or 'front' directors are treated as co-debtors for the tax assessed at 27.5% on deemed Egyptian-source income; courts may order personal asset confiscation and travel bans; participation in a sham arrangement with knowledge of evasion may trigger criminal liability.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Collecting high-volume crowdfunding proceeds through Kickstarter/Stripe/PayPal without customer due diligence; using founders' personal bank or cryptocurrency accounts to receive corporate sales revenue; structuring large international transfers to avoid scrutiny or failing to declare them to the EMLCU.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under AML Law No. 80/2002 as amended by Law No. 36/2024: imprisonment of 1 to 7 years and fines from EGP 100,000 to EGP 2,000,000 for laundering proceeds; the EMLCU may order freezing of the LLC's accounts, blacklisting, and withdrawal of banking facilities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors responsible for AML compliance are personally subject to criminal penalties where the LLC was used as a conduit for funds without identifying beneficial owners or suspicious transaction reporting; personal assets may be seized and international travel prohibited during investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Dividend WHT Evasion / Misreporting of Distributions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing dividends to non-resident shareholders without withholding the 10% dividend tax; disguising profit distributions as 'loan repayments', 'reimbursements', or 'technical service fees' to avoid WHT; failing to file the withholding reconciliation return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The LLC is the primary obligor for the unwithheld 10% WHT plus the 2% monthly delay surcharge and a fixed fine of EGP 1,000 to EGP 10,000 for each unfiled withholding return; disguised payments are re-characterized as dividends and treated as non-deductible.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under Article 11 of Law No. 91/2005, managers and directors are jointly and severally liable with the LLC for all unwithheld taxes and surcharges; ETA may issue collection orders, travel bans, and preventive seizure against personal assets until full settlement.
